scope: Source audit and planning only; no BK FPGA top-level, SD port, synthesis, programming or physical SD write.

cpu11.variant: vm1_wb, VM1_CORE_MULG_VERSION=0, default generic register RAM

rom_loading: User-selected Pyldin scheme: VM1 resident EBR bootstrap -> FAT16 LOADER.BIN -> ROM payload in SRAM -> stream/readback CRC32 -> retained lock -> native MONIT10.

checks.name: Eagle SCH/BRD pinout consistency
checks.result: Verified 3 SCH/BRD pairs, 432 FPGA pins; 10 files up to date.

checks.name: vm1_wb Icarus elaboration
checks.result: All four upstream WBC RTL files elaborate.

checks.name: vm1_wb register MOV stream
checks.result: Icarus executes 20 consecutive MOV R0,R1 fetches from 100000; steady interval is 6 vm_clk_p periods with immediate memory ACK. This is not a BK 3 MHz validation.

checks.name: uJ11 SRAM controller
checks.result: 37 checks: byte lanes, banks, 2MiB boundary, retention, power-on and handshake

checks.name: uJ11 PAL encoder
checks.result: 33834 samples; all RGB332 codes/both V phases; max error 1.846 DAC codes

checks.name: uJ11 generic PAL EBR model
checks.result: 1024 addresses, byte data, read latency and gating; vendor DP8KC model not run

checks.name: Reference C emulator headless ROM boot and keyboard input
checks.result: Boot: PC 101064, PSW 000004, SHIFT 001330. PRINT 2+2 produces 4 and returns to Ok; screen dumps visually inspected.
checks.limitations: Calls bk_hw_handle_key directly, without PS/2 transport; no tape or hardware clocks; temporary harness compiled original sources without modifying them.

checks.name: Experimental standalone VM1 ROM smoke in Verilator
checks.result: No Wishbone transactions in timeout window; reset/two-phase model and temporary harness need investigation. Not evidence of a core defect. Full RTL ROM boot remains unverified.
checks.resolution: Resident/full MONIT+BASIC boot now passes with explicit PLM masks; see tests/tb_plm_equivalence.v, tests/tb_reference_boot.v and build/results-boot.json. Historical result retained.

checks.name: Experimental Icarus full ROM smoke
checks.result: Stopped long-running temporary audit simulation; no ROM boot result claimed.
checks.resolution: Resident/full MONIT+BASIC boot now passes with explicit PLM masks; see tests/tb_plm_equivalence.v, tests/tb_reference_boot.v and build/results-boot.json. Historical result retained.

checks.name: New BK SD bootstrap, BK video, synthesis and board
checks.result: Implemented native two-stage SD/FAT16, CPU/system bridge, SRAM/PAL/PS2/clock/panel, full cold and warm boot plus physical PS/2 PRINT 2+2. ROM/VRAM byte-exact. See build/results-*.json. Diamond and physical board pending.

checks.name: uJ11 board button controller
checks.result: 28 checks, HOLD=100: boot release, bounce, one short release event, long hold/reset/release, held power-on and all seven sample phases.
checks.historical_limitations: Unmodified uJ11 short event is HALT. BK frequency selection and warm-reset rate retention are not implemented or tested.
checks.follow_up: BK-specific frequency/panel and full integration now pass in simulation; physical timing/board remains pending.

checks.name: uJ11 HC7000 single-segment scanner
checks.result: Three accelerated CLOCK_HZ cases (32000, 768000, 1600000), 48 frame/duty checks and 192 reset phases; continuous one-segment, polarity and blank-interval assertions.
checks.historical_limitations: Tests uJ11 diagnostic glyphs and activity dots; BK decimal frequency glyphs, clock switching, synthesis and physical LED currents remain unverified.
checks.follow_up: BK-specific frequency/panel and full integration now pass in simulation; physical timing/board remains pending.
